correctness.rationale: Projection parametrization P=vvᵀ/S, Q=aaᵀ/(aᵀa) has objective A(t)²/S(t), so derivative A W/S² with W=2SA′−S′A. For n≥2 the top t^(3n-1) cancels, next coefficient -2a_(n-1) generically nonzero, yielding deg W=3n-2; squarefree S and generic coprime squarefree A exclude cut and poles, a two-jet codimension-two incidence proves W has distinct roots, and infinity has generically nonzero derivative. Independent sympy samples for n=2,3,4,5 reproduced degrees 4,7,10,13 and mutual coprimality. Generic n cut roots from A are excluded, leaving 3n-2 of total 4n-2. Finite experiments corroborate the generic proof.
residual_risks: Generic rank-one complex projection data only, with isotropic charts removed; nongeneric or real counting excluded.
Sample sympy checks n<=5 not sufficient for n arbitrary; argument relies on jet incidence.
